sections.title: Executive Summary + Investment Thesis
sections.body:
**Executive Summary**
Nestle India Limited (NESTLEIND) reported a total income of ₹202,604.2 million for the financial year ended 31st March 2025, with a profit after tax of ₹33,145.0 million. The company's revenue from operations, net of GST, was ₹200,775.0 million, while other operating revenues and other income contributed ₹1,240.6 million and ₹588.6 million, respectively. The company's profit from operations, an additional information presented in the statement of profit and loss, stood at ₹43,104.1 million. As of 31st March 2025, the company's retained earnings balance was ₹40,089.5 million.

**Investment Thesis**
Our investment thesis for NESTLEIND is based on its stable financial performance and growth prospects. With a strong brand portfolio and a wide distribution network, the company is well-positioned to leverage the growing demand for food and beverages in India. The company's investment in associate company, Dr. Reddy's and Nestlé Health Science Limited, with a carrying amount of ₹5,750.3 million as of 31st March 2025, is expected to contribute to its long-term growth. However, the lack of comparable information for the associate company, due to the investment being made on 24th July 2024, limits our ability to assess its impact on NESTLEIND's financials. With an earnings per share of ₹34.38 and a dividend per share of ₹25.50 (interim and final), the company offers an attractive return to shareholders. Overall, we believe that NESTLEIND's strong brand presence, diversified product portfolio, and growth prospects make it an attractive investment opportunity.

sections.title: Management Commentary
sections.body:
The management of Nestlé India Limited has provided commentary on the tax expense for the year ended 31st March, 2025. According to the filing excerpts, the total tax expense for the year comprises of current tax and deferred tax, amounting to ₹10,817.4 million. The current income tax charge is calculated based on the tax laws enacted or substantively enacted at the end of the reporting period. The management also evaluates positions taken in tax returns with respect to situations where tax regulations are subject to interpretation or under dispute with authorities, and establishes provisions where appropriate. 

The provision for current tax for the period includes estimated tax expense accrued on the profit for the period from 1st April 2024 to 31st March 2025, as well as the residual tax expense for the period from 1st April 2023 to 31st March 2024. Deferred taxes are recognised on temporary differences between the carrying amount of assets and liabilities in the balance sheet and its corresponding tax base. The management has also stated that deferred tax assets are recognised only to the extent that it is probable that future taxable profits will be available against which such assets can be utilized. However, no peer comparison is possible as the provided excerpts do not contain data on peer companies.

sections.title: Key Risks
sections.body:
The 'Key Risks' section of this report highlights potential concerns that may impact NESTLEIND's financial performance and stability. One key risk is associated with the company's investment in its associate company, Dr. Reddy's and Nestlé Health Science Limited, which was made on 24th July 2024. As of 31st March 2025, the carrying amount of this investment was ₹57.50 billion (5,750.3 million). The associate company's financial performance, with revenue of ₹2.15 billion (2,148.8 million) and profit of ₹1.61 billion (1,607.9 million) for the financial year ended 31st March 2025, may have a significant impact on NESTLEIND's consolidated financials. Any adverse changes in the associate company's performance could negatively affect NESTLEIND's financial position.

Another risk arises from the consolidation adjustments related to the investment in the associate company, which amounted to ₹1.89 billion (1,886.0 million) as of 31st March 2025. This adjustment may indicate potential volatility in the valuation of the investment, which could impact NESTLEIND's net worth and profitability. However, without additional information on the company's overall financial performance and position, it is challenging to assess the full extent of these risks. Peer comparison is not possible due to the lack of available data.

sections.title: Recent Developments
sections.body:
The recent developments at NESTLEIND indicate a notable shift in the company's dividend payout policy. For the financial year ended 31st March 2025, the Board of Directors has recommended a final dividend of ₹10.00 per equity share, amounting to ₹9,641.6 million. This recommendation is subject to approval by the shareholders at the ensuing Annual General Meeting. Additionally, the company has paid an interim dividend of ₹17.00 per share for the financial year 2024-25. It is worth noting that the company's equity shares underwent a sub-division on the record date of 5th January 2024, where one equity share with a face value of ₹10 was sub-divided into 10 equity shares with a face value of ₹1 each.

In terms of geographical revenue, the company generated ₹192,926.7 million in revenue from external customers in India for the financial year ended 31st March 2025, while revenue from outside India stood at ₹7,848.3 million. The company's total income for the financial year ended 31st March 2025 was ₹202,604.2 million, comprising ₹200,775.0 million from the sale of products, ₹1,240.6 million from other operating revenues, and ₹588.6 million from other income. The company's profit after tax for the financial year ended 31st March 2025 was ₹33,145.0 million, with an earnings per share of ₹34.38.

sections.title: Bull vs Bear vs Base Case
sections.body:
The bull case for NESTLEIND is supported by the company's recent investment in Associate Company, Dr. Reddy's and Nestlé Health Science Limited, with a 49% ownership interest and a carrying amount of ₹5,750.3 million as of 31st March 2025. The associate company has reported a profit of ₹1,607.9 million for the financial year ended 31st March 2025, with revenue of ₹2,148.8 million. This investment could potentially drive future growth and profitability for NESTLEIND.

The bear case, on the other hand, is limited by the lack of comparable information for the associate company, as the investment was made on 24th July 2024. Additionally, there is no peer comparison data available in the provided excerpts, making it challenging to assess NESTLEIND's performance relative to its industry counterparts. Our base case assumes that NESTLEIND will continue to benefit from its diversified portfolio and investments, with the associate company contributing to the company's overall profitability. However, without more detailed financial information, it is difficult to estimate the exact impact of this investment on NESTLEIND's future performance. As of 31st March 2025, the associate company's net assets were ₹7,886.3 million, with NESTLEIND's share being ₹3,864.3 million, which could provide a potential upside to the company's net worth.
